committee.sub: Morning brief · Tuesday 22 September 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Ad spend was $156.45 over the last 7 days versus $147.98 the week before, for 25 clicks and still zero conversions. Post-restart clicks sit at 49 of the 150 that would trigger the stop-loss.
Impression share is 10% with rank lost at 73.9% against budget lost at 20.7%, so the budget conversation has not opened yet. CTR slipped from 4.2% to 3.4% week on week.

In Search Console data through 19 Sept (two days behind, as usual), 'kontrol ai' ranks position 1 and took 4 of 7 total clicks, while 'simpro integration' and 'procore xero integration' sit past position 40 with zero clicks. Of 57 sessions this week, 30 landed on / and 21 on /ai-automation-agency.html.

AI Assistant sessions rose to 2 last 7 days from 0, led by chatgpt.com, though this likely undercounts because many AI referrals arrive with no referrer and get logged as Direct. LinkedIn stayed at 0 sessions both periods.

actions.text: Ship the logo and image assets and get keyword-matched RSA headlines live for the currently serving ad groups.
Fix the homepage form so kontrolTrackLead fires only on the Formspree confirm-then-count verdict, not before it.
Rewrite RSA description D1, which still claims 13.3 hours of admin per week, to match the current site stats.
